route: 350 main pages in reading-order, then all 277 details blocks, batches no more than three adjacent pages; append understanding before next batch
sampling_principles_before_any_preview: Select from source features, not peer findings: a wide branching or merging figure, a figure translating labels or axes, a dense comparison table or formula, a long code/output page, a details disclosure, an introduction-to-lesson transition, and a numeric boundary such as x.9 to x.10.
Inspect samples at desktop 1280x800 and mobile 390x844; scroll then wait at least 900ms; record source feature and actual location.
Exercise sidebar and previous/next clicks in the actual localhost preview; compare resulting numeric order to reading-order.
Select concrete pages as their main text is reached; freeze selection before opening corresponding preview. Layout findings are sample findings, never all-page visual coverage.
figure_method: Render frozen original SVG with /usr/bin/chromium, existing NotoCJK, actual DOM bounding box preserving width/height units; actual view_image precedes later call appending observations.
independence: No peer, history, git diff/log or author-private consulted. Task assignment explicitly requested reading project-context, whose facts are not counted as student prior knowledge. Shared filesystem does not provide physical isolation.
execution: No notebook rerun claimed; final-executed03 if consulted will be attributed to root. No installation or formal training.
